lastCompletedStory.title: Add cam pause / cam resume operator brake backed by a dedicated pause marker

nextStoryContext: cam pause / cam resume are wired end-to-end: src/supervisor/pause-marker.ts (PAUSE_MARKER='.cam-pause', setPause/clearPause/isPauseSet, injectable fs seams, mirrors drain-kill-switch.ts) is the marker module; src/commands/pause.ts is the print-path command (cam pause, no flags besides --help); runResume (src/commands/resume.ts) calls clearPause(claudeDir) at the top of its flow (skipped under --dry-run) before any mode classification; performStop (src/commands/stop.ts) removes PAUSE_MARKER as part of its per-session marker cleanup loop. index.ts wires 'pause' into COMMANDS, HELP_REGISTRY, and the dispatch switch (mirrors the 'drain' case). Gotcha for future stories: adding/removing a top-level cam subcommand requires updating test/commands-freeze.test.ts's hardcoded FROZEN_COMMANDS array AND its toBe(N) count literal in the SAME commit -- typecheck alone does not catch a drift there (see the new patterns.md bullet). Scope note: this story deliberately does NOT wire isPauseSet into the sidecar loop's gating logic (loop.ts) -- the acceptance criteria only covered the marker module + pause/resume/stop commands + gitignore + gates, not actual loop-pause behavior; if a future story wants the sidecar to actually halt on the marker, that is new scope requiring loop.ts changes plus a real behavioral gate.
